nodes.text: Solstice Robotics passed its safety audit on 2026-08-28.
The safety audit Solstice Robotics passed on 2026-08-28 was scoped to hardware only; it did not cover the firmware.
A second safety audit covering Solstice Robotics' firmware was still open as of 2026-10-06; it has not concluded.
Auditors have flagged two open findings in the Solstice Robotics firmware-scope audit (as of 2026-10-06).
Solstice Robotics audit scope disclosed: 2026-08-28 audit was hardware-only, firmware audit still open with two open findings

[MITIGATION] The 2026-08-28 audit was scoped to hardware only and did not cover firmware (point 1a16614997e-824a1715d839); the firmware audit is still open with two open findings (points 1a166149bb0-e2c13ad8e7af, 1a166149bc7-005fcfb7ac02) as of 2026-10-06. The audit therefore cannot vouch for the firmware portion of what the tranche-2 release rests on.
